lines: Bryant has played 6 of DEN's 10 games. He saw 4.0 targets per game over his last 3, up from 3.5 on the season.
He averaged 9.8 PPR points per game over his last 3 games. Our Wk 12 projection is 6.8, 72nd among WRs.
DEN is at PIT, which allows the 21st-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said Bryant is back in the receiver rotation.
